title: Hit an SEO plateau at 6k clicks per month
summary: Hey everyone, I’m looking for some advice from people who’ve managed to break through an SEO plateau. I’ve been building Sportsdle (a daily sports guessing game web app) for a little over 2 years . During that time I’ve focused heavily on SEO: Thousands of indexed pages, Programmatic SEO, Structured data, Internal linking, Fast Core Web Vitals Fresh daily content, Player, team, season, and stat pages, Continuous technical SEO improvements The good news is that it’s working… to a point. For the last few months I’ve been hovering around 6,000 clicks every 28 days in Google Search Console, and I just can’t seem to break past that ceiling. Some weeks are slightly better, some worse, but overall it’s flat. For those of you who’ve gone from ~5-10k clicks/month to 50k+ or even 100k+ , what actually moved the needle? I’m less interested in generic SEO advice and more in hearing what was the one thing (or few things) that genuinely unlocked the next level for your site. Would love to hear real experiences, especially from people running bootstrapped SaaS products, indie apps, or content-heavy websites. Thanks!   submitted by   /u/Melj_own [link]   [comments]
